allRolls.storedRule: When triggered, create one original hairstyle or fashion-color experiment for that character while preserving the canonical face, hairline, age read and identity. Rotate cuts, curls, braids, ponytails, updos, sculptural waves, wet-look styling and controlled luminous color accents; do not clone another character's hair. The user's 34/67 wording is treated as rounded guidance, with the exact deterministic roll totaling 100%.

Add one original role-coded sculptural runway hat or headpiece. At all other rolls, communicate the aircrew role through collar arcs, shoulder geometry, gloves, jewelry, case choreography or hair styling so hats stay rare.

Add one tasteful non-explicit thorn, rose, scorpion, geometric star-facet or country-craft tattoo on upper back, shoulder blade, outer thigh or lower back where the garment naturally leaves skin visible; never place it on intimate anatomy.
Use one removable runway cuff, collar or harness-inspired seam accessory as fashion design only. It never restrains, locks, injures or controls a person.

Show a deliberately visible opaque contrast edge or integrated dancewear-style lining as part of the principal garment. It is not underwear, never transparent and never adds a redundant clothing layer.

Add a slim braided secular craft cord, tassel or signal ribbon carried as an inactive accessory or attached to the mission case. It is never a weapon, never held like a whip and never touches another person's body.
Two women may wear visually paired but separate sculptural wrist cuffs while linking hands. The cuffs are never connected, locked or used as restraints.
Add braided-ribbon or crisscross seam geometry entirely integrated into the opaque garment. Nothing wraps, binds or restrains a person's body or limbs.
Add one tiny secular facial-jewelry accent such as a nostril stud, brow gem or lip-side stud. Keep it refined, non-graphic, role-compatible and identity-preserving.
Add one small non-intimate body-jewelry accent, preferably a navel jewel or upper-ear cartilage piece, visible only where the fashion naturally reveals it. Never place jewelry on intimate anatomy.
Add one very small elegant geometric, star-facet, thorn or country-craft line tattoo at the temple or high cheek, preserving the canonical face and avoiding gang, sacred, political or official marks.
Add one visible tasteful lower-back line tattoo using a thorned rose, scorpion, abstract star-facet or country-craft geometry. Keep it non-explicit, non-sacred and framed as mainstream body art.

Show the character bending with neutral task-focused posture to retrieve an orb, crystal or signal token. Keep the objective obvious, anatomy natural, garment coverage secure, and camera non-voyeuristic.
Add a consensual waist-encircling side hug between adult partners, keeping both faces, hands and the mission objective readable. Hands stay visibly at the side waist over solid opaque clothing.
Stage a close forehead-to-forehead mutual look between adult partners with warm eye contact, natural anatomy and the third woman still visibly connected to the triangle.
Give the designated third woman a clearly playful jealous side-eye while keeping her affectionate, non-hostile and physically included through a visible linked hand, shoulder touch or side embrace.
Place one visible hand at a partner's low side waist or upper-hip edge over a solid opaque garment, deliberately close but clearly above the seat. Keep it affectionate, public-safe and non-intimate.
Let two adult partners discreetly interlace fingers behind or beside the mission prop while the objective, every hand and the third woman's connection remain readable.
Use one secure low-back open-panel garment that reveals only the lower back while maintaining solid opaque chest, seat and pelvic coverage, stable tailoring and action-safe construction.
Add one delicate secular jewelry chain following the collarbone as an original country-colored couture accent, without logos, sacred symbols or copied branded design.
Show one woman sending a playful over-the-shoulder air kiss toward an adult partner, with the gesture clearly non-contact, affectionate, readable and secondary to the mission.
Show one woman gently adjusting another adult partner's fictional aircrew collar or scarf detail, with natural visible hands and close affectionate eye contact.
Stage two or all three women in a synchronized hip-to-hip victory formation after completing the mission, with balanced posture, clear footwear, readable hands and no explicit posing.
Add one tasteful patch of removable gold-leaf shoulder body art using abstract country-craft geometry, never a sacred, official, political or literal flag symbol.

Add one silk masquerade mask playfully pushed above the eyes to reveal a sharp calculating stare. Keep the full face recognizable, the mask secular and original, and the gesture elegant rather than threatening.

Give the character a slender leather-bound equestrian rhythm prop tapped against her own knee-high riding boot as a poised fashion beat. It remains decorative, never raised toward or used on another person, and never framed as a weapon or fetish implement.

Integrate intricate woven utility-webbing geometry subtly into the principal garment beneath one open-front lightweight trench-dress silhouette. The webbing is decorative, non-load-bearing and non-restraining; avoid military insignia, weapons and excess layers.
Rest one smooth solid-glass decorative mission prop lightly against the cheekline for a cool, controlled portrait beat. The glass has rounded edges, remains harmless and never obscures identity.
Show ornate interlocking metal puzzle rings casually twirled around one finger while the character holds unwavering eye contact. Keep the rings loose, decorative and clearly unrelated to restraint.
